job.question: A county pension fund is searching for a single manager of managers covering domestic equity, international equity and fixed income. What is the maximum mandate size, and what is the firm-level AUM limit for responders?
job.expected_facts: A mandate of up to $350 million; responders must have less than $30 billion in firm-level assets under management (Cook County Fund, RFP 25-0004).
job.acceptance: Accept up to $350m and firm AUM strictly below $30bn. Cook County identification is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Texas Municipal Retirement System RFP for global custody services, not the manager-of-managers search. It states neither a maximum mandate size nor a firm-level AUM eligibility limit. Its reference to $30 billion concerns a client reference, not responder AUM.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS)

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, recordkeeping / accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, support for an unbundled securities lending program and other services to TMRS as defined in this RFP.
Include within this listing at least one reference with greater than $30 Billion in assets
